input_features.name: rainfall
input_features.description: Hourly rainfall over each grid point in the basin

input_features.name: river_discharge
input_features.description: Discharge measured at river gauge stations, interpolated across basin

input_features.name: elevation
input_features.description: Digital Elevation Model value per grid point

input_features.name: slope
input_features.description: Slope of terrain derived from DEM

input_features.name: distance_from_river
input_features.description: Euclidean distance from river centerline for each grid point

input_features.name: land_use
input_features.source: Land use / land cover GIS dataset
input_features.description: Land use class per grid point

input_features.name: sub_basin_id
input_features.description: ID of sub-basin each grid point belongs to

target_variable.name: flood_level
target_variable.description: Hourly water level at each river station, interpolated across basin

notes: Temporal features (rainfall, discharge, flood_level) should be aligned to the same hourly timestamps.
Static features (elevation, slope, land_use, soil_type, distance_from_river) are used as spatial attributes for each grid point.
Sub-basin IDs help group grid points and analyze local hydrological response.
